summary_en: This study tests two-fraction high dose rate (HDR) brachytherapy given alone as monotherapy, in men with localized prostate cancer. The radiation is given as 13.5 Gy in 2 fractions during a single implant procedure, with the fractions 3 hours apart; the total duration and any other schedule details are not stated. This single-center pilot study investigates safety, and the record lists the phase as NA.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la braquiterapia de alta tasa de dosis (HDR) en dos fracciones, administrada como monoterapia, en hombres con cáncer de próstata localizado. La radiación se administra como 13.5 Gy en 2 fracciones durante un solo procedimiento de implante, con las fracciones separadas por 3 horas; la duración total y otros detalles del esquema no se indican. Este estudio piloto de un solo centro investiga la seguridad, y el registro indica la fase como NA.
who_for: Favorable intermediate risk prostate cancer by NCCN criteria
Eligible for HDR monotherapy as judged by the treating radiation oncologist
not_for: Any prior treatment for prostate cancer or any prior androgen deprivation therapy
Prior pelvic malignancy or prior pelvic radiotherapy
IPSS score of 15 or higher before treatment
